fullPassage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.

❌ hastily(성급하게): 서두르는 내용 없음
❌ deliberately(의도적으로): 의도적 행동이 아닌 어색한 행동
det.tip: Uncertain → awkwardly: 불확실 → 어색한 행동

questions.passage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.
questions.stem:
다음 중 이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"Sophie는 벽화를 어머니와 함께 그렸다."

det.korean: 아버지(father)와 함께 그렸으므로 어머니라는 서술은 거짓입니다.
det.analysis: F — painted with her father ≠ 어머니
det.tip: with her father = 아버지와 함께
